name: business-central-mcp-esanpons
description: Direct access to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (on-prem and BC Online/SaaS) via its native WebSocket protocol.

bc_base_url.title: BC base URL
bc_base_url.description: Business Central server base URL, e.g. http://your-bc-server/BC

bc_username.title: BC username
bc_username.description: NavUserPassword username for the BC server.

bc_password.title: BC password
bc_password.description: NavUserPassword password for the BC server.

bc_profile.title: BC profile
bc_profile.description: Optional profile id, e.g. BUSINESS MANAGER. Affects which Role Center loads and which pages Tell Me indexes.

bc_application_id.title: BC application id
bc_application_id.description: Optional navigationContext.applicationId for OpenSession. Leave empty for the default (NAV on-prem, FIN on SaaS). BC 27 expects NAV; FIN triggers NavCancelCredentialPromptException. Override only for other builds.

bc_auth.title: Authentication mode
bc_auth.description: Leave empty for on-prem (NavUserPassword forms auth). Set to AAD for BC Online / SaaS, which additionally needs an interactive one-time sign-in (npm run login:aad) to create the browser profile.
